title: Evaluation of an Addition Gate
statement: Let $F$ be a commutative ring, let $v$ assign an element of $F$ to each input index, and let $a,b$ be arithmetic circuits. Evaluating the circuit formed by adding $a$ and $b$ gives the sum of their evaluations: $(a+b)(v)=a(v)+b(v)$.
hypotheses_covered: The coefficient structure is a commutative ring
An input assignment and two circuits are given
